abstract: Exact rank-two equivalence of finite permutations by quadrant-mask sets, the nine-mask almost-sure type, shortest nine-point representative, and a sharp logarithmic-over-linear stabilization rate; rank-three failure by a classical Poisson succession event.
integrity: Proof steps and executable finite checker provided; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted rank theory not classified; Poisson succession is classical; historical priority unresolved for full Foy--Woods (1990) chapter; no independent audit.
title: Sharp rank-two stabilization for uniformly random permutations
